hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Sort passenger requests by floor destinations.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Segment requests into contiguous batches fitting inside elevator capacity.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Each batch cost is twice the highest floor destination in that batch.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minElevatorCost(requests: list[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    requests.sort(reverse=True)
    total = 0
    for i in range(0, len(requests), capacity):
        total += 2 * requests[i]
    return total
```
